title: Who is the Messiah? David's son or Lord?
description: While the Pharisees were gathered, Jesus asked them a question about whose son the Messiah is. They answered, "David's son." Jesus challenged them by pointing out that David, inspired by the Spirit, calls the Messiah his Lord, quoting the words that the Lord will set him at his right hand until his enemies are made a footstool for his feet. How then can the Messiah be David's son? No one could answer him a word, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.
